description: This file contains unit tests for the RootRouteExceptionHandler class, focusing on its exception handling capabilities within an HTTP routing context. It verifies immutability, exception handling logic, and behavior with various exception types using the Akka HTTP framework and Mockito for mocking dependencies.

classes.name: RootRouteExceptionHandlerTest
classes.description: Unit test class for RootRouteExceptionHandler, verifying exception handling behavior in HTTP routes using Mockito and Akka HTTP.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment before each test, setting up the exception handler instance.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Verifies that the RootRouteExceptionHandler class and its dependencies are immutable.

methods.name: tryToGetInstanceWithNullFunction
methods.description: Ensures that passing null to getInstance() throws a NullPointerException with the appropriate message.

methods.name: handleDittoRuntimeException
methods.description: Tests that a GatewayMethodNotAllowedException is correctly handled by delegating to the provided function.

methods.name: handleJsonRuntimeException
methods.description: Tests that a JsonMissingFieldException is correctly handled and wrapped in a DittoJsonException.

methods.name: handleCompletionExceptionWithUnhandledRuntimeExceptionAsCause
methods.description: Verifies that unhandled RuntimeExceptions wrapped in CompletionException lead to an internal server error response.

methods.name: handleCompletionExceptionWithDittoRuntimeExceptionAsCause
methods.description: Tests handling of CompletionException wrapping a DittoRuntimeException, ensuring proper delegation.

methods.name: handleCompletionExceptionWithJsonRuntimeExceptionAsCause
methods.description: Verifies handling of CompletionException wrapping a JsonRuntimeException.

methods.name: handleUnknownExceptionAsInternalServerError
methods.description: Ensures that unknown RuntimeExceptions result in a 500 Internal Server Error response.

methods.name: handleUnknownErrorAsInternalServerError
methods.description: Ensures that non-Exception Throwables (like AssertionError) result in an internal server error response.

methods.name: getTestRoute
methods.description: Helper method to create a test route that executes the provided route supplier.
